text:
Leah: Heads-up: new model catalog iteration uploaded. Two quick asks: where should the latency badge live and how do we show pinned versions without clutter? figma: https://figma.redwood/mock/catalog-ux-iter2

Omar: Latency badge should be adjacent to the model name, small label like "P99 120ms". If we put it in a separate metrics column it reads as table-level data.

Tess: For pinning, avoid always-visible pins. Show a subtle timestamp line under the name like "v2.1 • pinned 2024-08-11" and reveal a pin icon on hover/focus to avoid visual noise.

Hiro: Accessibility: badges need text + icon, not color-only. Also ensure contrast >= 4.5:1. Make the pin action keyboard reachable and announce changes with aria-live.
Leah: Good — what about compact rows vs spacious rows? Compact helps scannability but breaks multi-select compare flow.
Omar: Keep compact but make compare checkboxes sticky left and enlarge click targets. Also surface a floating compare CTA when items selected.
Tess: Copy nits: change placeholder to "Search models, tasks, or tags (press /)"; change generic "Perf" label to "P99 latency".
Hiro: One more a11y detail: ensure focus order is name -> version -> badge -> actions. Use visually-hidden separators if needed so SRs read natural order.
Leah: Action items: I'll update the mock with badge left of name, timestamp-based pin display, sticky checkboxes, and new placeholder. Will tag you all for review. Thanks!
